subject: Planned migration windows + exception gating for model v2 rollout
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.p@oliveai.com>, Ben Caldwell <ben@cloudops.ai>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Planned migration windows + exception gating for model v2 rollout

Team —

We need to align on the migration cadence for model v2 rollout to hosted API customers and the exception gating process if a customer needs more time. Olive AI (Sarah) is on the thread — they're planning to take the new model but asked for a 4-week soft landing window due to heavy eval runs.

Key asks to resolve this week: 
- Confirm migration windows (dates/times) and whether we support per-account staggered windows.
- Define the exception / exemption approval flow (who signs off, expected SLAs for approval).
- Operational constraints: canary size, telemetry signals for rollback, and a minimal notice period for customers.

I've attached a rough "migration_window_matrix.xlsx" with three proposed windows (evening UTC schedules) and a draft customer notice (customer_notice_draft.md). Please review and call out any blockers.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to lock the gating flow and notify Customer Success.

Thanks,
Naomi
Director, Customer Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: migration_window_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), customer_notice_draft.md (markdown)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.p@oliveai.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planned migration windows + exception gating for model v2 rollout

+1 on Naomi's timeline. Quick notes after skimming the matrix: 
- Ops constraints: we should avoid weekday mornings (US) because of peak low-latency traffic — prefer 22:00-02:00 UTC windows. 
- Staggered windows are possible per-account but we should limit to two days of staggering max to keep KCaches and plan durable KV cache migrations.
- Canary recommendation: start at 2% traffic, evaluate generation latency P95 and error-rate delta for 48 hours, then 10% for another 24 hours before full cutover.

I've attached a small telemetry sample (canary_telemetry_sample.json) to show the signals we would use for the rollout dashboard.

Question for Product / Biz: who has final signoff for exceptions that go beyond 4 weeks? I think for >4 weeks we need an exec-level exception (Sales + PS + Product).

-Marcus
Senior PM, Serving Runtime

Attachments: canary_telemetry_sample.json (json stub)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T13:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planned migration windows + exception gating for model v2 rollout

Thanks — a couple practical items from the ops playbook perspective: 
- Notice period: Ops needs 7 business days to reserve capacity for staggered migrations and to schedule infra maintenance windows. If a customer asks for a last-minute exception, we'll need a 72-hour minimum for most cases (unless emergency).
- Backout plan: must include an automated rollback step and a manual escalation path. For manual rollback we need a single PagerDuty runbook owner — propose "infra-rollout-oncall".
- Telemetry thresholds: propose absolute thresholds (latency P95 > baseline + 60ms OR error rate increase > 0.5%) to trigger immediate automated rollback.

If Sales needs an extended customer window (4+ weeks soft landing), Ops expects a signed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that includes a known traffic cap for the customer during that window. Aditya — can Sales commit to getting these MAPs signed for enterprise customers?

-Monica
Senior Engineer, Reliability
From: Sarah Patel <sarah.p@oliveai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planned migration windows + exception gating for model v2 rollout

Thanks for the transparency — Olive wants to avoid surprises. A few constraints from our side: 
- We run nightly full-eval suites; a soft landing window helps us validate embeddings and generation differences. 4 weeks is our ask, but we can consider 2 weeks if there is an assurance on smaller canary traffic and stable latency.
- For MAP: procurement needs the commitment in writing (HubSpot/DocuSign) that the traffic cap will be enforced and that we won't be throttled without notice.

Two quick asks: could you provide a short example customer notice we can send internally (we received the draft — thank you) and confirm the SLA during the soft landing window? If SLA changes, we need to route it through our procurement team.

Best,
Sarah
Head of Platform Partnerships
Olive AI
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.p@oliveai.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planned migration windows + exception gating for model v2 rollout

Summary and next steps (action items):

1) Migration windows — agreed target windows: 2027-05-10 22:00-02:00 UTC and 2027-05-17 22:00-02:00 UTC (finalize in tomorrow's sync). Ops requires 7 business days notice for per-account staggering. (Owner: Monica)
2) Canary plan — 2% -> 10% -> full rollout if telemetry OK (Owners: Marcus + Infra)
3) Exception gating — exceptions up to 4 weeks are Approver: Sales Lead (Aditya). Exceptions >4 weeks require Sales + Product + CS exec signoff. Sales to secure signed MAP for any >2 week soft landing. (Owner: Aditya)
4) Customer notice — Naomi to send revised short notice for Olive and share the DocuSign/HubSpot link for the MAP. (Owner: Naomi)
5) Telemetry rollback thresholds — Monica to publish thresholds and a runbook; infra-runbook will be linked in the rolling playbook. (Owner: Monica)

Meeting: 30-min sync scheduled 2027-04-26 17:30 PT (confirmed) — will use this to finalize signoff matrix and customer notice language. 

Naomi
Director, Customer Strategy
Redwood Inference

Related links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDEF-customer-notice-draft
